The analyst problem

Find what needs review. Keep the decision human.

Work to reconcile

Compare segment changes and portfolio claims, inspect narrative support, and trace every question to its source.

Lumen’s role

Automate repeatable checks and evidence navigation; prioritize questions. It does not decide legality or filing readiness.

Workflow value is a hypothesis: no analyst trial or time-savings result is claimed.

02 / 09
What is new

A pre-review layer, not a filing portal

SERFF

NAIC electronic filing workflow for preparation, submission, review, and dispositions.

Lumen adds local arithmetic/evidence triage; it does not integrate or replace SERFF.

ChatGPT data analysis

General file analysis through uploaded spreadsheets and natural-language questions.

Lumen adds fixed calculations, review-scoped tools, validated citations, and reviewer history.

Spreadsheet + checklist

Flexible and familiar; analyst manages formulas and source navigation.

Lumen packages repeatable checks and traceability, with added model/validation risk.

Adjacent-product comparison, not a superiority benchmark. Sources and qualifications are in the report.

03 / 09
A controlled multi-agent workflow

Separate calculation from interpretation

01 · ValidateBounded CSV/XLSX, narrative, documents
02 · CalculatePython Decimal engine
03 · ExplainRate Analysis Agent + read-only tools
04 · InspectDocumentation Agent + citations
05 · VerifySchema/evidence checks; human disposition

Model: official OpenAI Python SDK · gpt-6-luna. The model selects tool calls; Python owns numbers and explicit bound checks.

No shell, web, or arbitrary code tools. The documentation agent retrieves its own evidence and receives only a bounded rate-agent handoff.

Scale scenarios

$0.24 per month for 100 users at one same-sized review each; $24.27 for 10,000. Ten reviews/user: $2.43 and $242.69.

06 / 09
Safety and governance

Make errors visible, bounded, and reviewable

Prompt injection

Filing content is untrusted; tools are scoped/read-only; adversarial synthetic test evidence is preserved.

Fabrication

Python owns values; numeric bindings, retrieved IDs, exact quotes, and output schemas are validated.

Failure and cost

Request/output limits, bounded retry, usage audit, and preserved deterministic output on AI failure.

A Phase 5 prompt correction requires an explicit unsupported factual/regulatory assertion. H02 is not yet re-scored live; no improved accuracy is claimed.

Synthetic data only. No legal-compliance determination, regulator integration, or automatic approval.

07 / 09
Impact evidence

Useful prototype; real-world value remains to be tested

Known

  • Recorded seeded holdout results.
  • Completed historical browser flows.
  • Both agents connected through direct OpenAI API.

Not known

  • Analyst time saved or ROI.
  • Representative filing accuracy.
  • User acceptance, quality, or regulatory impact.

Next evidence: blinded human analyst trial measuring time, issue precision/recall, corrections, traceability, and confidence.

Five small seeded cases are regression data, not a population benchmark. H02 had one extra documentation finding; historical results remain unchanged.
